annotations.title: Make music video for a song

description: Make a music video for the user's song (up to 60 seconds of it), vertical 9:16 or 16:9, in any Film Studio look (neon club, rap video, stage performance, retro camcorder, k-pop, anime and more). The song is split into sections at lyric gaps and each section is filmed in one pass to its own slice of the song, so the performer's lips follow every word, with the cast's faces kept from portraits; then it is cut under the original song with a title card and saved to the Library. create is free and returns the plan and price (about 1.25 credits per second of song plus portraits); produce films it; then call status until it is finished (10-15 minutes).

action.description: create (default, free): hears the song, splits it into sections and writes the plan; returns music_video_id and the price. Show both and wait for the user's OK. produce (charged): films it. status (free): progress; call every ~60s until it returns the video. redo (charged): re-film chosen sections, then it cuts again.

artist.description: Create (optional): the artist name for the title card.

beats.description: Redo: the section numbers to film again.

cast.description: Create (optional): up to 3 characters, the performer first, each with a portrait on the PixelDojo CDN.

image_url.description: A clear front-facing portrait on the PixelDojo CDN.

name.description: The character's name; the first one is the performer.

end_screen.description: Create: an end screen after the song. Default off.

end_text.description: Create: the end screen's line, up to 60 characters.

idea.description: Create: the story or performance concept in a line or two.

length_sec.description: Create (optional): seconds of the song to film, 10 to 60. Default 60 or the rest of the song.

look.description: Create (optional): the visual style, e.g. neon-club, rap-video, stage-performance, retro-camcorder, k-pop.

mature.description: Create: true for adult work (the server also detects it from the idea). Runs on the less-restricted engines.

music_video_id.description: From create. Required for produce, status and redo.

notes.description: Redo (optional): what to fix in each of those sections, in the same order.

song_title.description: Create (optional): the song title for the title card.

song_url.description: Create: the song on the PixelDojo CDN (attach or upload it first).

start_sec.description: Create (optional): where in the song to start, in seconds. Default 0.

title_card.description: Create: the song title over the opening. Default on.
